name: Qdrant FastEmbed README
notes: FastEmbed README. ONNX Runtime based, explicitly no PyTorch/GB-scale torch dependency, GPU via a separate fastembed-gpu package with CUDAExecutionProvider. Supports dense, sparse (SPLADE++) and LateInteractionTextEmbedding (colbert-ir/colbertv2.0) - the only engine in this slice that ships a ColBERT multi-vector encoder path in a first-party package.
